scope.surface: Compact Composer overflow menu, inline Files panel, Composer context containment, scroll behavior, mode mutation, selected-state persistence, and outside dismissal

productLoss: The first valid Browser pair showed Web as one 146x537 column with 14 rows, while Lynx rendered a fixed 232x320 two-column card with 13 rows.
Lynx omitted Web's separate Chat and Plan rows and instead showed one Build toggle row.
The fixed 320px menu had no viewport-derived height contract; a short Native viewport needed real scrolling instead of clipping or extending off-screen.
Native's fullscreen dismiss sibling covered compact menu rows under its original stacking contract, so row taps closed the menu without dispatching a mode mutation.
After a real mode command, stale shell snapshots could overwrite the optimistic interaction/runtime mode before the canonical event arrived.
harnessMismatch: The first compact-menu attempt used an already-built Web authority bundle without the new stable relation marker. Lynx opened correctly while Web did not; the run was rejected and Web was rebuilt.
Lynx DevTool returns nodeId=-1 when a selector has no match. Early scripts treated only nodeId=0 as absent and falsely reported that a successfully dismissed menu remained open.
An outside tap at x=20 landed in the Sidebar's higher interaction surface. The retained dismissal uses x=900,y=300, outside the menu and inside the measured fullscreen dismiss layer.

An early context check compared the Composer strip against the inner file surface at x=693 instead of the outer inline panel boundary at x=740. Correct outer-boundary measurements prove zero overlap in both renderers.
intentionalPlatformDelta: Web uses Base UI's portal Menu and backdrop behavior; Native uses an absolute menu plus a fullscreen transparent dismiss layer.
Native accepts fractional text and layout quantization, while Web uses variable DM Sans and Base UI material.
acceptedRenderingNoise: Final panel geometry differs by 0.609375px in x, 2px in y, and 1.78125px in width.
The context strip remains within the chat column in both renderers; residual context pixels are typography/material, not cross-panel placement.
classification.evidenceBoundary: Browser before and after use one immutable snapshot, selected thread, dark theme, 1280x820 viewport, 540px inline Files panel, Web authority bundle, real menu triggers, and clean console. Exact-bundle Native independently proves 1280x600 scroll overflow, 14 rows, Plan mutation, selected-state persistence, fullscreen outside dismissal, main transport sequence advancement, and isolated cleanup. Native pixels are representative and are not used as a Web parity residual.

fidelityImpact.modelChange: Add composer-compact-controls-open as state 50 with Lynx and Native clients.

lossAccounting.boundary: The former 49-state 0.382759 checkpoint is not directly comparable after denominator expansion. Coverage gain and measured product gain are separate ledger points.

remainingRisk: The final menu material residual remains visible because Web uses Base UI glass and variable-font rendering while Native uses Lynx token material.
Physical mouse-wheel evidence remains pending-user-session; the exact Native run proves real scrollTo behavior and overflow geometry through the viewport-test seam.
Web's local update notification appears in the authority screenshot; it is outside the Composer/menu crop and unchanged across before/after.
